grants.description: Verify your identity if applying without a solicitor or conveyancer
grants.purpose: HM Land Registry requires proof of identity for all applications not made by legal professionals

grants.description: Share property deeds and ownership evidence with HM Land Registry
grants.purpose: To establish legal ownership and register the property

grants.description: Consent to property details being made publicly available
grants.purpose: Property information is legally required to be available to the public. You cannot opt out.

grants.description: Authorise search of Land Charges Department records for previous owners since 1925
grants.purpose: To identify any charges or restrictions on the property from previous ownership

grants.description: Share Stamp Duty Land Tax or Land Transaction Tax information with HM Land Registry
grants.purpose: Required documentation for property purchases to complete registration

grants.description: Authorise your solicitor or conveyancer to act on your behalf
grants.purpose: If using legal professional, they will handle the entire registration process on your behalf

revocation.mechanism: Contact HM Land Registry Citizen Centre in writing or through your solicitor
revocation.effect: Registration will be cancelled if consent is revoked before completion. Property will remain unregistered or ownership will not be transferred.

delegation.agent_identity: Solicitor, Conveyancer, or GOV.UK AI Agent
delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make payment without explicit authorization. Agent cannot change property boundaries without surveyor certification. Agent cannot alter deed information without your confirmation. If using AI agent, complex cases (inheritance disputes, unregistered interests, agricultural land) will be handed off to human professional.
